facts.about: Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd (HAL), a 71.64% Government-owned Maha-Ratna CPSE, designs, manufactures, upgrades and provides lifecycle MRO for aircraft, helicopters, aero -engines, avionics /accessories and aerostructures, principally for India’s armed forces.

flags.text: Operating leverage: profit +16%/yr vs sales +7%/yr over 3 years
Operating margin expanded 5 pts in 3 years (25% → 30%)
Cash-rich profits: 5-yr operating cash = 144% of PAT

business.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and maintains aircraft, helicopters, aero-engines, and aerospace systems. It primarily serves national defence requirements through indigenous aerospace platforms and provides space-worthy hardware for ISRO missions.

segments.name: Manufacturing and Repair and Overhaul
segments.note: Covers aircraft, helicopters, engines, rotables, and spares.

guidance.statement: We are hopeful that we'll be maintaining a double-digit growth in the current financial year '26-'27.
guidance.quote: As far as revenue growth is concerned, we are hopeful that we'll be maintaining a double-digit growth in the current financial year '26-'27.

guidance.statement: The EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.
guidance.quote: And the EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.

guidance.statement: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
guidance.quote: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.

guidance.statement: The guidance for revenue growth is 8% to 10% for the current year.
guidance.quote: But the guidance is 8%-10%, and it may so happen a double-digit growth from next year onwards.

guidance.statement: We will be maintaining 31% at operating level.
guidance.quote: we will be maintaining 31% at operating level.

guidance.statement: We have formulated a comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years of Rs. 14,000 to 15,000 crore.
guidance.quote: In line with our strategic goals, we have formulated a comprehensive CAPEX plan for the next five years, with an estimated outlay of Rs. 14,000 to Rs. 15,000 crore.

guidance.statement: The aggregate value of the order pipeline is estimated at around Rs. 1 lakh crores.
guidance.quote: The aggregate value of the order pipeline is estimated at around Rs. 1 lakh crores and are expected to materialize within the next one to two years.

guidance.statement: We expect to bring it down further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: The manpower cost which used to be around 23% of the revenue during the year 2018-19, some 5 years back, has consistently been rationalized to almost 17% during the last financial year i.e. ‘23-24 and we expected to bring it down to further to 16% of revenue in the current financial year.

guidance.statement: The CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be between 14,000 to 15,000 crores.
guidance.quote: So, the CAPEX plan for the next 5 years is estimated to be somewhere between 14,000 to 15,000 crores which translates into an average CAPEX of almost 3,000 crores on annual basis.

guidance.statement: We expect the outstanding order book position to be around 1,20,000 crores by 31st March 2025.
guidance.quote: With these orders and the other ROH order book as on the 31st March ‘25, we expect the outstanding order book position to be somewhere around 1,20,000 crores even after liquidation of the certain portion of order as part of the revenues for the year ‘24-25.

guidance.statement: We expect EBITDA margins to be between 29% and 33% in the next 2-3 years.
guidance.quote: Broadly what we expect the EBITDA margins should on the most optimistic note it could be somewhere—around 32% to 33%. And at the minimum level it should be not less than 29%

guidance.statement: We will be able to reach a double-digit growth of 10% from '24-'25 onwards.
guidance.quote: And as we have indicated in the few last calls, we will be able to reach a double-digit growth of 10% from '24-'25 onwards.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margin will settle down at 26%, 27%.
guidance.quote: This, again, I would like to clarify that may not be sustainable at 31%. We will settle down at 26%, 27%.

guidance.statement: We expect estimated order value of almost INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year.
guidance.quote: So we expect estimated order value of almost INR48,000 crores to get concluded in the coming financial year, which means within a time span of 6 to 10 months.

scorecard.promised: Double-digit growth of 10% from FY25 onwards.
scorecard.delivered: FY25 revenue grew only 2% to ₹30,981 crore.
scorecard.evidence: FY25 revenue of ₹30,981 cr vs FY24 ₹30,381 cr is a 1.97% increase, far below the 10% target.

scorecard.promised: Maintain margins around 30% to 31% through FY27.
scorecard.delivered: Maintained 31% in FY25 and 30% in FY26.
scorecard.evidence: Operating margins held steady at 31% in Mar 2025 and 30% in Mar 2026 despite revenue volatility.

scorecard.promised: Outstanding order book of ₹1,20,000 crores by March 2025.
scorecard.delivered: Order pipeline estimated at ₹1,00,000 crores in FY25.
scorecard.evidence: Management cited a ₹1 lakh crore pipeline in Q4 FY25, slightly trailing the ₹1.2 lakh crore target.

scorecard.promised: Reduce manpower cost to 16% of revenue in FY25.
scorecard.delivered: Not explicitly disclosed in numbers, but margins remained stable.
scorecard.evidence: While margins are healthy, the specific 16% cost-to-revenue ratio requires further segmental confirmation.

narrative.scoreline: Management has successfully defended high margins and cash flows, but consistently struggles to meet its own double-digit revenue growth and delivery timelines.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Receivables have been reduced to an optimal level of 55 days.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Debtor days stand at 45 days as of March 2026.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Inventory holding has been optimized to 159 days.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: The cash conversion cycle has ballooned to 788 days.

narrativeVsNumbers.claim: Confident of sustaining double-digit growth momentum.
narrativeVsNumbers.reality: Annual revenue growth averaged 4.4% over the last two fiscal years.

bull: Operating margins expanded from 25% to 30% over three years, demonstrating strong pricing power and cost control.
Exceptional cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow reaching 144% of total PAT.
The company remains practically debt-free with a ₹41,041 crore net worth and zero net debt.
bear: Revenue growth missed the 10% target significantly in FY25, coming in at just under 2%.
The cash conversion cycle has deteriorated to 788 days from 475 days three years ago.
Repeated delays in LCA Mark-1A deliveries risk liquidated damages and impact credibility with the primary customer.
watch: First LCA Mark-1A delivery in August/September 2026 to validate supply chain recovery.

claims.claim: We are hopeful that by August or September, we should be able to start the deliveries.
claims.quote: So we are hoping to resolve everything and stabilize by August or September.

claims.claim: We are identifying multiple vendors to mitigate risks and ensure timely delivery of platforms.
claims.quote: what we are trying to do is we are trying to identify more than one vendor for the supply of items, whether it is indigenous or from a foreign source

claims.claim: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in manufacturing infrastructure projects by 2030.
claims.quote: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.

claims.claim: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year up to December.
claims.quote: GE has promised a supply of 12 engines in this calendar year up to December. This is confirmed, and they will be sticking to this schedule.

claims.claim: We will be having this kind of installed capacity of about 24 numbers for LCA.
claims.quote: So, coming to capacities, we will be having this kind of installed capacity of about 24 numbers.

claims.claim: The value is expected to be around Rs. 60,000 crores, and that will start kicking in from the 6th year onward.
claims.quote: The value is expected to be around Rs. 60,000 crores, and that will start kicking in from the 6th year onward.

claims.claim: We will be able to deliver these helicopters Starting '27, '28 to 5 years from then.
claims.quote: So, we will be able to deliver these helicopters Starting '27, '28 to 5 years from then, these helicopters will be delivered.

claims.claim: We are confident of sustaining double-digit growth momentum due to a robust order book and strong pipeline.
claims.quote: With our robust order book and a very strong pipeline we are confident of sustaining this growth momentum.

claims.claim: Inventory holding has been optimized to 159 days, which is the optimal level.
claims.quote: today it stands somewhere around 159 days which we feel it's the most optimal level below which we would not intend to reduce further.

claims.claim: Receivables have been reduced to 55 days, which is the optimal level to be maintained.
claims.quote: it has now been brought down to 55 days which is again the optimal level. I think that will be maintained in the next few years as well.

claims.claim: We are augmenting capacity to 24 aircraft annually to expedite deliveries and complete orders by 2032-33.
claims.quote: We wanted to augment the capacity to 24 numbers because we want to expedite the delivery of this 83 Mark 1A and anticipating further orders

claims.claim: HAL achieved 9.37% revenue growth in FY23 and expects to reach double-digit growth from FY25 onwards.
claims.quote: So that we could achieve a revenue target of growth of 9.37% in the last financial year. This year would be no different from that. We will be further strengthening that.

claims.claim: Deliveries are scheduled to start from February 2024, with 3 aircraft planned for the current financial year.
claims.quote: In the current financial year, we are supposed to deliver 1 fighter and 2 trainer, total 3 aircraft during the current financial year. And we are on the track.

claims.claim: Recent accidents are not due to design flaws; the fleet remains safe and robust.
claims.quote: So there's no design in all these 3 helicopters as of now. Out of these, for 2 preliminary investigations have been completed.

risks.text: Non-compliance with board composition and committee requirements due to vacant independent director positions.
Significant liquidated damages recognized in profit and loss due to manufacturing and delivery delays.
Related party transactions exist, though none were material during the fiscal year.
Voluntary winding up of Infotech HAL Ltd, a joint venture, is currently in progress.
